use default
use Raster.COLOUR_MAP
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math
use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let peaks =
    [(x = -1.2D, y = -0.8D, height = 1.0D, spread = 1.0D),
     (x = 1.4D, y = 0.9D, height = 1.4D, spread = 0.8D),
     (x = 0.2D, y = -1.6D, height = -0.9D, spread = 0.7D)]

height_at(x: double, y: double) -> double =>
    peaks
        |> map(peak =>
            (let across = x - peak.x
             let up = y - peak.y
             let away = across * across + up * up

             peak.height *
             Math.exp(-away / (2.0D * peak.spread * peak.spread))))
        |> reduce(0.0D, (total, part) => total + part)

let left = -3.0D
let bottom = -2.4D
let right = 3.0D
let top = 2.4D

let steps = 120

sample(column: int, row: int) -> Point =>
    (x = left + (right - left) * cast double(column) /
                cast double(steps),
     y = bottom + (top - bottom) * cast double(row) /
                  cast double(steps))

crossing(from: Point, from_height: double,
         to: Point, to_height: double, level: double) -> Point =>
    (let part = (level - from_height) / (to_height - from_height)

     (x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * part,
      y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * part))

contour(level: double) -> Pipe[(from: Point, to: Point)] is
    for row in 0..steps do
        for column in 0..steps do
            let south_west = sample(column, row)
            let south_east = sample(column + 1, row)
            let north_east = sample(column + 1, row + 1)
            let north_west = sample(column, row + 1)

            let a = height_at(south_west.x, south_west.y)
            let b = height_at(south_east.x, south_east.y)
            let c = height_at(north_east.x, north_east.y)
            let d = height_at(north_west.x, north_west.y)

            let corners =
                (if a > level then 1 else 0 fi) +
                (if b > level then 2 else 0 fi) +
                (if c > level then 4 else 0 fi) +
                (if d > level then 8 else 0 fi)

            let south = crossing(south_west, a, south_east, b, level)
            let east = crossing(south_east, b, north_east, c, level)
            let north = crossing(north_east, c, north_west, d, level)
            let west = crossing(north_west, d, south_west, a, level)

            let middle = (a + b + c + d) / 4.0D > level

            case corners
            when 1, 14 then yield (from = west, to = south)
            when 2, 13 then yield (from = south, to = east)
            when 3, 12 then yield (from = west, to = east)
            when 4, 11 then yield (from = east, to = north)
            when 6, 9 then yield (from = south, to = north)
            when 7, 8 then yield (from = west, to = north)
            when 5 then
                if middle then
                    yield (from = south, to = east)
                    yield (from = west, to = north)
                else
                    yield (from = west, to = south)
                    yield (from = east, to = north)
                fi
            when 10 then
                if middle then
                    yield (from = west, to = south)
                    yield (from = east, to = north)
                else
                    yield (from = south, to = east)
                    yield (from = west, to = north)
                fi
            else
            esac
        od
    od
si

let levels =
    (0::12) |> map(step => -0.75D + 0.15D * cast double(step))
            |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(600, 480)

image.view(left, bottom, right, top)

let lowest = -1.0D
let highest = 1.5D

for pixel_y in 0..image.height do
    for pixel_x in 0..image.width do
        let spot =
            image.to_user(cast double(pixel_x), cast double(pixel_y))

        let part =
            (height_at(spot.x, spot.y) - lowest) / (highest - lowest)

        image.colour(COLOUR_MAP.viridis(part))
        image.set_pixel(pixel_x, pixel_y)
    od
od

image.colour(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)
image.stroke(1.1D)

write_line("level   segments")

for level in levels do
    let pieces = contour(level) |> collect_list()

    write_line("{level,6:F2}{pieces.count,11}")

    for piece in pieces do
        image.line(piece.from.x, piece.from.y, piece.to.x, piece.to.y)
    od
od

image.write("contours.png")

image.show("contours.png")
